description: This source file defines the class DebugManagedDataSource, which extends ManagedDataSource to include debugging features such as verbose logging of connection borrowing and a method to retrieve pool information.

classes.name: DebugManagedDataSource
classes.description: A managed data source with additional debugging features such as verbose logging and connection pool info retrieval.

methods.name: DebugManagedDataSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DebugManagedDataSource with a connection pool and transaction registry.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to include verbose logging of pool usage before returning a connection.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns a map containing detailed information about the connection pool, including active, idle, and total connections, as well as configuration parameters if the pool is of type GenericObjectPool.
